children: Tokenized stock-related tokens rose after the U.S. SEC introduced an innovation exemption policy for tokenized stock trading. According to Odaily, UNI reached as high as $7.93 in the past 24 hours, up more than 14%; ONDO climbed to $0.3792, up more than 7%; and BP touched $0.55, up nearly 14%.
The SEC said the exemption provides a five-year trial framework for qualified tokenized securities trading venues.

title: Tokenized Stock-Related Tokens Rise After SEC Innovation Exemption Proposal
